main.description: Rekey a karute encrypted record. Generates a fresh per-record sym_key, re-AEAD-encrypts the plaintext, writes a new com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope, emits new keyWrap records for the (possibly reduced) recipient set, and writes an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.tombstone pointing prior→successor. Used for: scheduled rekey, member removal (consent revocation flush), key compromise rotation, data correction. Per ADR-2605231603.

newRecipientDids.description: Recipient set for the SUCCESSOR. Excludes removed members.

innerType.description: MUST match the prior record's innerType (one of com.etzhayyim.karute.*)
